title: Acme Genomics — Inference Rollout Status Log
content:
Purpose:
A living rollout tracker for Acme Genomics' migration to Redwood Dedicated for inference pipelines (variant calling + report gen). Use this to keep milestones, owners, blockers and near-term actions visible across CS, Solutions Eng, and Platform.

Customer context (summary):
- Customer: Acme Genomics (clinical research division).
- Primary use: batched variant-calling model + short-report text generation for nightly jobs and on-demand analyst queries.
- Target SLA: 200ms p50 for on-demand queries, nightly batch throughput 3M tokens/hour.
- Deployment mode: Dedicated (reserved GPU pool), VPC peering to customer network.
- Contract renewal window: Q2 2026 (ties to Dedicated commit expansion).

High-level rollout phases (current RAG):
1) Discovery & sizing (COMPLETE, owner: Sophie Chen) — Green
   - Deliverable: workload profile, seq length distribution, peak concurrency estimate. Doc: CON-ACME-SIZING-2025
2) Dedicated environment provision (IN_PROGRESS, owner: Miguel Alvarez) — Yellow
   - Deliverable: provisioned GPU pool + network connectivity. Target: 2025-11-10
3) Model onboarding & perf tuning (IN_PROGRESS, owner: Applied ML -> Daniel Park) — Yellow
   - Deliverable: quantized variants, kernel selection, and validated perf matrix. Target: 2025-11-20
4) Integration testing (PENDING, owner: Solutions Eng -> Sasha) — Amber
   - Deliverable: end-to-end tests against staging with customer test vectors. Target: 2025-11-30
5) Cutover & runbook (PENDING, owner: Customer Success -> Priya Kapur) — Green
   - Deliverable: production cutover plan, rollback criteria, on-call rotation. Target: 2025-12-07
6) Post-cutover stabilization (PENDING, owner: SRE) — Green
   - Deliverable: 2-week stabilization window with performance SLO validation. Target: 2025-12-21

Milestones (detailed rows):
- M1: Finalize sizing doc — Owner: Sophie Chen — Due: 2025-09-20 — Status: done — Notes: workload traces collected from customer TBX cluster.
- M2: VPC peering + firewall rules applied — Owner: Miguel Alvarez — Due: 2025-10-30 — Status: in_progress — Blocker: customer network team needs to allow egress UDP 1194 for monitoring agent; ticket CSINF-512 open.
- M3: GPU pool allocation (n1-high-gpu x8 equivalent) — Owner: Miguel Alvarez — Due: 2025-11-10 — Status: in_progress — Notes: waiting on quota increase from cloud provider.
- M4: Model quantization validation (int8 + per-channel) — Owner: Daniel Park — Due: 2025-11-20 — Status: in_progress — Blocker: small accuracy drop on rare variant classes; running targeted eval suite.
- M5: Staging integration tests (end-to-end dataset) — Owner: Sasha (Solutions Eng) — Due: 2025-11-30 — Status: pending — Test vectors: acme-testset-v2 (5k prompts).
- M6: Production cutover rehearsal — Owner: Priya Kapur — Due: 2025-12-05 — Status: pending — Notes: schedule tabletop with customer ops.

Current blockers (top 3):
1) Network approvals delay (impact: environment provision & monitoring).
   - Owner to drive: Miguel Alvarez
   - Mitigation: escalate via CSM executive sponsor + share minimal ports checklist.
2) Minor regression on quantized model for low-frequency classes (impact: acceptance tests).
   - Owner to drive: Daniel Park (Applied ML)
   - Mitigation: run targeted calibration and revert to higher precision fallback for those classes; plan A/B test in staging.
3) Cloud quota increase pending (impact: GPU pool delivery date).
   - Owner to drive: Platform Eng (Miguel)
   - Mitigation: temporary burst nodes on shared capacity while quota approved; cost estimate prepared.

Near-term action items (next 7 days):
- Miguel: Confirm firewall rule list with customer network (due 2025-11-04).
- Daniel: Run focused eval for rare variant classes and submit result summary (due 2025-11-06).
- Priya: Schedule cutover rehearsal and invite SRE, Solutions Eng, customer PM (due 2025-11-07).
- Sophie: Send final acceptance checklist to customer and align on test pass criteria (due 2025-11-05).

Communication cadence and owners: 
- Weekly sync: Customer Success <> Solutions Eng <> Applied ML, Thursdays 10:00 PT (owner: Priya).
- Bi-weekly exec check-in: Customer exec sponsor + Redwood AE (owner: Miguel).
- Slack channel: #cs-acme-genomics (Use for day-to-day blockers).

Acceptance criteria for cutover: 
- Staging test suite pass rate >= 98% on functional tests and model quality thresholds.
- On-demand latency p50 <= 250ms in staging under 5 concurrent users.
- Nightly batch throughput within 10% of sizing target.
- Customer sign-off on runbook and rollback plan.

Runbook snippets (quick refs):
- Rollback criteria: if p50 exceeds 400ms OR nightly batch throughput < 70% for two consecutive nights, trigger rollback to previous model pin and engage on-call SRE.
- Emergency contact list: Priya Kapur (CS), Miguel Alvarez (Platform), Daniel Park (Applied ML), Sasha (Solutions Eng), SRE rotation: oncall+infra.

Notes / history / context: 
- 2025-09-12: Initial sizing workshop with Acme ops; agreed to target dedicated pool instead of hosted due to data residency.
- 2025-10-02: Customer provided sample traces and acceptance vectors.
- 2025-10-28: Network team requested hardened egress policy; created ticket CSINF-512.

Open questions for customer (to confirm ASAP):
- Do they require HSM-backed KMS for model keys (affects private key rotation timeline)?
- Can the customer accept a staged fallback to a higher-precision model for rare-variant calls during first 2 weeks?

Document maintenance: 
- Update tracker after each Thursday sync.
- Move completed milestones to done + add short retrospective note.

Quick links: 
- Confluence plan: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/ACME-Genomics-Plan
- Jira epic: CSINF-512
- Infra PR for temporary burst: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/2345

Last updated by: Priya Kapur on 2025-11-02 — summary: VPC peering scheduled, quantization tests ongoing, quota escalation initiated.
